defect: address decode result is supplied by an unspecified map implementation
rationale: The reduced decoder instantiates a stub for the configured address map. Its matching ranges, default behavior, overlap priority, and output drive are not given, so whether idx_o and valid_o are correct for any address is undecidable.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the address-decoder wrapper shape but represented its dynamic map provider as an intentionally opaque stub.

mutation.description: The address map implementation is omitted, leaving its ranges and drive behavior unspecified.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Stub module has no body so output driving behaviour cannot be decided.
